DZA.note: Platform is described as a satisfaction-feedback channel for station visitors; no application or payment service is named.

facts.fact: L'Actualgerie reports the Interior Ministry launched on 22 March 2025 a police-services digital platform designed and developed by engineers and staff of the Sûreté nationale.

DZA.note: Document states nothing on local government offices.
The platform gives access to services and measures user satisfaction; no report or case record made at stations is stated.
